_rule: No generated image of a real person, place or event anywhere in the archive, decoration included (Nathan, 8 October 2026); every banner listed here until then was one, and all were taken off. An AI-generated image may otherwise be page decoration, clearly labelled. It is never a record, a portrait, or a relation to the person or thing it depicts. Banners are files in web/banners, listed here and nowhere else: not assets, not in any volume, not in any field, never in JSON-LD. check_render.php enforces it (docs/DATA-MODEL.md, Generated images).
_fields: file: the name in web/banners. sha256: of that file. record: section and id of the page it decorates, with the title as a check. kind: always ai-generated-illustration. tool, sourcePhotograph, generatedOn: how it was made; null means not yet recorded, and the page says so. commissionedBy (shown), commissionedByPerson (not shown), received, receivedAs: how the archive came to have it. scrimClear (optional): where the scrim behind the type becomes clear, default 50%. formerAsset (optional): the archive asset this image was, before the rule; check_render fails while that asset still exists.
